text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Daring Heart was attending a rehearsal
for a TV program she was scheduled to appear on.

text_block_list.name: Show Director
text_block_list.text:
"‘Generation Spotlight! Physical No. 1 Championship!’
We're starting rehearsal! Let's make it a great one!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just because it's a rehearsal
doesn't mean I'll let you win, you know?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is essentially a preliminary skirmish.
I'll get a feel for things and use it as a foundation for victory.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm giving it my all right from the start, too.
I definitely want to win the real race—
so I can become an inspiration to any kid watching on TV!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Since we are appearing in our racewear,
we must lead by example for those who follow.

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... That's a good pace.
This 'Athletic Race' is mine for the taking!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm barely keeping up...! —But this is where it really begins!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Shoot! You were saving your energy
for your specialty, climbing, weren't you, Craft?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
They're already that far ahead—
Then in the next event...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Pardon me, Heart-san, but I'm passing you.
With this dribble taught to me by my father...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Darn it! You're pretty good...!

text_block_list.name: Question Audio
text_block_list.text: ""Fingers on the buzzers. Please name the class of polyunsaturated fatty acids that cannot be synthesized by the human body.""

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"She's so sharp...! 
Even though she must be exhausted by now!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I train myself to keep a cool head even when exhausted.
It's for the future, when I must guide the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Show Staff
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, take a break until the actual performance!
Great job, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart wasn't able to take 1st place
in any of the events.
Even if it was just a rehearsal, anxiety lingers—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I was confident in all of them...
As expected of my acknowledged rival.

text_block_list.name: Show Director
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Heart-san, Trainer-san!
I am so sorry. Due to a lack of research on my part,
the events ended up heavily favoring the other three's specialties.

text_block_list.name: Show Director
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any events you're particularly good at?
We can still add them in now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I want her to win.
However, will Daring Heart
accept that—
choice_data_list: ...Heart, what do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's no need to hesitate.
There is only one Answer!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Let's stick with the current events as they are!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Craft's route choice was excellent, too.
If I want to pull ahead, I'll need to construct a strategy from another angle."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart ran match simulations right up
to the very last moment before the race.
However, the moves available now are limited—
choice_data_list: You were admirable, struggling all the way to the end.
You are admirable for struggling all the way to the end.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that a little defeatist?
Of course I'm going in planning to win!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Competing in an away match at a disadvantage
is second nature to me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: An unfamiliar land, a new culture, an uncertain future. I factored all of that in the moment I came to Japan.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I'm not so weak that I'd beg for a handicap just because I'm inexperienced!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's keep preparing right up until the main event.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll prove my prowess
by winning! A fair and square showdown!

text_block_list.name: Show Staff
text_block_list.text:
It's almost showtime!
All Umamusume, please get ready!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...I wonder if Heart-san will be okay. It looked like she was pushing herself right to the edge, though."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That is not our concern.
...It is a matter for Miss Heart herself.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. In fact, Heart-san is at her most formidable
when she gets like that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look who understands.
I'm the one who's going to win.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So you're here... You're not to be underestimated after all.
I'll take you down with everything I've got, holding nothing back!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A serious showdown is just what I wanted.
Come at me,
my worthy opponents!
choice_data_list: I'll be cheering you on with all I've got too!
I'll cheer for you with all my heart too.
I believe... that you can win...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A serious showdown is just what I wanted.
Come at me,
my worthy opponents!
choice_data_list: I'll be cheering you on with all I've got too!
I'll cheer for you with all my heart too.
I believe... that you can win...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so then my feelings will count for double?
Ufufu, that actually puts me at an advantage, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“Still, precisely because it's a serious match, I'll do whatever it takes.
Naturally, I'll be borrowing your strength too.”

text_block_list.name: Show Staff
text_block_list.text:
Alright, please make your way to your designated positions!
Thank you very much in advance!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on your passionate gaze♪
I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh? And here you seemed so anxious during rehearsal.
—Just teasing, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My results just weren't there at the time,
so it couldn't be helped, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, experiencing defeat has only lit a fire in me.
No holding back, we're charging straight through!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I will return victorious……
Just you wait and see!
